title: Pinned polynomial resolution and contraction data
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a normed field $F$ with a normed $\mathbf Q_\ell$-algebra structure, and $r\in\mathbf N$. Use the all-continuous scalar ring [def-sfb-bundled-continuous-scalar-ring], lattice [def-sfb-ladic-lattice], internal modules and actions [def-sfb-condensed-action-module, def-sfb-condensed-equivariant-bar-data], and ordinary derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Define polynomialArrow as the finite integer linear combination of monomial coprojections, deletion as the alternating block-renaming sum, insertZero by setting the leading block to zero, and translatedMonomial by diagonal substitution $y_{a,i}\mapsto y_{a,i}-g_i$. Model is the specification of an equivariant integer-indexed cochain complex zero in negative degrees, with monomial coproducts, the sectionwise translation formula, individual equivariant deletion faces, alternating differential and constant augmentation. Contraction specifies underlying internal linear maps given by zero evaluation/insertion and the split, zero-degree and positive-degree identities. Assertion says that a Model exists and that every Model has a Contraction, quasi-isomorphic augmentation and invertible image of the augmentation in the ordinary derived category. These are the existing definitions, moved verbatim; no existence result is included in this definition node.
